limitations: Generated side/back views are interpretations, not ground-truth 3D measurements.
Accepted nose profile, jaw angles and some locks still differ from the canonical portrait.
Fitting, skinning and facial morphs are constructed at runtime; the GLBs remain unrigged.
The mouth is a shaded surface opening, not an anatomical cavity.
Native engine VMs load the new mesh with sampled vertex colours; their separate shaders do not yet reproduce the browser hair/cloth ink. Device GPU performance is unmeasured.

findings: Eyes, continuous brows and principal fringe match much more closely than the previous head.
Nose/profile, chin/jaw and some hair locks still differ.
Most broad directional skin shading removed; fixed chin ink patch remains.
Hair interior drawing lost; nose and mouth ink weakened.
Game ink adds noisy extra contours to painted facial lines.
review.next: Integrated cleanup is available in Character Studio and the game; source viewer intentionally preserves the untouched export.
